method: Exact DOI lookup in Europe PMC; article and per-figure license screening; exact JATS graphic to PMC Cloud media match. Publication association is not specimen identification.
limitations: All DOI identifiers in the current atlas snapshot were queried, not every publication in human evolution.
Publication figures can depict multiple localities, analytical results or regional models. They are not automatically photographs of the selected individual.
Locality association identifies the place named in a checked caption, not every specimen or layer grouped there.
ROAD image fields exist but were not exposed in the supported public exports checked. Restricted files require an authorized export and per-image rights review.
AADR annotation rows provide sample and publication metadata, not an image for every individual.
No index match is not proof that the publication or its images are unavailable elsewhere.
